name: @cc/dsh-design-map
description: One Excalidraw design map per workspace: the agent writes nodes/edges through a tool, the human edits the same design.excalidraw in a Web panel, and both go through the same host service. The panel embeds a vendored Excalidraw frame (MIT) with a postMessage bridge, reads through workspaceFiles and saves through the /design-map command.
